Independently dynamic, ferocious when stacked. With four I/O jacks for full routing control, a versatile tone-shaping section, and intuitive controls like CLEAN, COLOR, PRESENCE, and COMP Imperium is your new sonic centerpiece. GLADIO and ANTIQUE Two sides of the same soul From subtle tone to full ROCK drive! The Imperium V2 combines the dynamic response of the Gladio SC with the creamy voice of the Antique in one compact and unit. Two of Cornerstone’s most iconic circuits, now reimagined to work together or independently. Gentle and Dynamic, Yet powerful and RockExplore the dual nature of the Imperium V2. From smooth, touch-sensitive overdrive to raw rock tones—use each side on its own or stack them for a wall of sound that’s articulate and powerful. A modern classic with vintage soul. On the Gladio SC side, the CLEAN knob lets you blend your dry signal with the overdriven tone—giving you total control over dynamics and clarity. The result? A touch-sensitive overdrive that feels like an extension of your fingers. On the Antique side, the PRESENCE knob adjusts the high-frequency content after the clipping stage—perfect for dialing in just the right amount of brightness to cut through the mix. Turn it up for added edge and clarity that cuts through the mix, or roll it back for warmer, vintage-flavored tones. Imperium V2 is equipped with four separate I/O jacks—one for each side’s input and output—giving you maximum flexibility in any rig. Use the Gladio and Antique circuits as two completely independent pedals, perfect for pedal switchers and advanced routing setups. Cornerstone Music Gear Cornerstone Imperium V2 Dual-Engine Overdrive Pedal - Gbase Gbase - Guitars Amps & More Gear Dealers Radar Events More Sections Gear Dealers Events Blog My Studio Account Join Login Create Store Help 1.0.735 Home Find Gear Find Dealer Gear Radar My Studio Events Blog Join Login Create Store Help Find Gear Miscellaneous Cornerstone Music Gear Cornerstone Imperium V2 Dual-Engine Overdrive Pedal The Guitar Sanctuary Description Two Icons. One Enclosure. Infinite Routing. The Cornerstone Music Gear Imperium V2 is the definitive "Phase 3" evolution of Cornerstone’s most celebrated circuits. By merging the D-style transparency of the Gladio SC with the mid-forward heat of the Antique, the Imperium V2 offers a dual-channel powerhouse designed for players who refuse to compromise on touch sensitivity and harmonic depth. The "Why" Behind the Imperium V2 Most dual overdrives force a specific signal path. The Imperium V2 breaks the mold. Featuring four independent I/O jacks, you are no longer locked into a single box. Use them as two standalone pedals, swap their order (Antique > Gladio or Gladio > Antique), or insert your entire modulation chain between them. Channel Breakdown: The DNA of Tone Side A: The Antique (Screamer-Inspired) The "Screamer" evolved. The Antique delivers that classic mid-range authority needed to cut through a mix, but with added transparency and "air" that traditional TS-style pedals lack. Presence Control: Shapes high frequencies post-clipping—perfect for matching the pedal to different amp voicings. Comp Switch: Toggle between a compressed, singing sustain or an open, dynamic response. Mids Switch: (V2 Internal/Optimized) Precisely tuned to maintain the circuit's characteristic punch without the "honky" nasal frequencies. Side B: The Gladio SC (Dumble-Inspired) Based on the legendary Gladio, this side provides the "Robben Ford" style breakup—creamy, touch-sensitive, and incredibly amp-like. Clean Blend: The "Secret Sauce." Mix your dry signal back in to preserve pick attack and low-end definition, even at high gain settings. Compression Toggle: Choose between "More" for a tight, boutique-amp feel or "Less" for maximum headroom. Routing Architecture: 4 Independent Jacks (TRS/Mono compatible) for split-path or switcher-based rigs. Switching: True Bypass (Relay-based). Power Requirements: 9V DC (Center Negative). Current Draw: ~100mA. Dimensions: 119mm x 94mm x 42mm (4.7" x 3.7" x 1.6"). Origin: Hand-built in Italy. To consult Contact an expert Our musician and enthusiast tele-consultants are here to answer all your questions. +33 181 930 900 email Overdrive, distortion & fuzz effect pedal Handcrafted in Italy from strictly selected components, the CORNERSTONE MUSIC GEAR Imperium V2 is a dual-channel overdrive that combines two of the brand's popular models, the Gladio SC and the Antique Classic Drive. Each section has its own controls for individual use. But the two circuits can be combined, with the possibility of determining their routing for absolutely impressive versatility. The CORNERSTONE MUSIC GEAR Gladio SC is based on the first channel of the original CMG Gladio, which had in its sights the sounds of artists such as Robben Ford and Sonny Landreth. On the Gladio SC, the addition of the "Clean" control allows you to move towards the mythical grain of Stevie Ray and his Dumble amps. The circuit redirects the clean signal at the pedal input directly to the output for mixing with the overdrive section. The CORNERSTONE MUSIC GEAR Antique Classic Drive is a high-quality traditional saturator, ideal for Rock/Blues tones. Its efficient controls and Mid and Comp filters give it great flexibility.
